notable.text:
Notes on CbcyNo7m1amFWqEQm2m4PLv1UNvpcL3C1Ujm6AkzpKoU (e/acc)

The ticker is an old tech slogan turned into a 4-day Solana meme. Most of the X tape is vote spam and TG shills.

Bull
~20k holders and eight-figure daily volume in under a week.
Top-10 hold about 16%. Mint looks revoked.

Bear
Coordinated launch wallets took ~32% at launch. If those bags are still live, that kills the thesis.
ATH is already ~3x above the current price.
Liquidity is thin against volume.
The vote/listing links on X are mostly netlify farms. Ignore them.

red_flags.detail: A contract write-up says coordinated launch wallets took about 32% at launch and calls that the thesis killer if those bags are still live.
The same accounts repeat “show up or miss the listing” copy for this contract with different netlify Moonshot vote links.
